summary: Prettier config package downloads Bun at preinstall to execute a 727 KB obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Prettier configuration (index.js exports formatting options), but its package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a sibling file `math_init.js` (or invokes an already-installed `bun` against the same file). `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line JavaScript file with heavy obfuscation: `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, hex/opaque identifiers, a string-array rotator function performing `push(shift())`, and a large numeric constant table. There is no relationship between an alternate language runtime and a Prettier config, and the obfuscated payload has no connection to the package's stated purpose. Pulling in a second runtime at preinstall specifically to execute an obfuscated sibling script bypasses Node-based scanners and results in arbitrary code execution on the installer's host on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
